payload.reason: The evidence provides specific word embedding models that were tested, including their names and descriptions.

claims.text: The tested word embeddings include Bernoulli embeddings (b-emb), continuous bag-of-words (CBOW), Distributed Memory version of Paragraph Vector (PV-DM), and Global Vectors (GloVe).
EqEmb is based on Bernoulli embeddings (b-embs) and extends the concept of word embeddings to equations.
